snippet.title: SOMA native VR mod - 6DOF motion controls test
snippet.description:
A native VR mod for SOMA using its existing HPL3 engine. This mod aims to bring 6DOF motion controls and intuitive VR gameplay to make it appear as native as possible.

What currently works:

- Native stereo rendering, dynamic FOV and resolutions (all VR headset resolutions, supersampling with SteamVR and Virtual Desktop, and FOVs supported). OpenXR runtime only.
- 6DOF Motion controls. Grab, throw, and manipulate objects. Use your hands to interact with the world.
- Physical hands with collision.
- Dynamic hand models. Simon's hand models will automatically change, depending on your progression with the story.
- Camera and hand recentering, menu options.

Come see the progress at Flat2VR's DIscord Server!

NOTE: If you're wondering why some parts of my game have low-resolution textures, it's because I'm using an HD texture pack, and HPL3 has issues when rendering high-resolution textures, and it takes some time for them to appear. It's nothing to do with my VR mod.
